name: corpus
description: Corpus — personal finance planner for salaried users in India. Web and mobile.

scripts.dev:web: npm run build:core && npm run dev -w @corpus/web
scripts.dev:mobile: npm run build:core && npm run start -w @corpus/mobile
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @corpus/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test -w @corpus/core
